text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I never thought I'd be standing here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But... I suppose it does mean I'm getting
noticed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can already see tomorrow's headlines.
"Aston
Machan Adds a Splendid Autumn
Victory to Her
Collection of Wins."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could I get a pre-race
quote?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Vodka! Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! So, what do you want to
hear?
Just my thoughts on the race?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well... the hot topic going into today's
race is
your showdown with Vodka, your
long-time rival.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If at all possible, I think the fans would
love to
hear the two of you formally
challenge each
other!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm going to show everyone just
how much
stronger I've gotten since the
Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Get ready to eat my dust, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh! You took the words right outta my
mouth!
I'm on fire this year!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter how far out in front you run,
just
remember that I'm comin' to take
the lead from
ya!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I wish both of you
the best of
luck!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...There they go. And I'm still here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No, I understand. I know they're popular.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I heard people in the audience asking
each other
which one they think will win.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, I announced that I was
going to
change to sprints. It's only
natural that I'd fall out
of the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
Yes, it's only natural. But still. I won't
let things
stay this way.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day. I'll make everyone
remember me
for sure.
